## Goal and scope

Describe the change and its owning issue / stacked PR dependency.

## Mathematics, conventions and provenance

- Inputs/outputs, units, coordinate/reference frame, UTC/UT1/TT, house or zodiac policy
- Original source and rights for any code, tables, formulas, fixtures or data
- Unsupported cases / validation errors and any change to public exports

## Verification (only checks actually executed)

- [ ] `npm test` — provide Node version and exact result
- [ ] TypeScript NodeNext/Bundler consumer checks — report result or not run
- [ ] Optional external DE441/Rust tests — specify pinned inputs, result or skip
- [ ] Relevant independent numerical references and precision limits
- [ ] Security, privacy, provenance and attribution reviewed

## Explicit non-changes

Confirm no unapproved release, public visibility change, production migration, private data, Swiss fallback or GitHub Actions. List any remaining blockers.
